Templates.Name: EDM dense-canvas Tree/Matrix
Templates.SourceNote: Derived from a real Tree/Matrix busiest-window scan (Sugar Plum Fairy / JayKode Trap Remix extracts); see docs/research/multilayer-template-exemplars/README.md. Palette-free and song-free -- no literal color or exact timing copied.

Layers.Notes: Fast ~150-250ms chase bursts, back-to-back, alternating a couple of Chase_Type variants -- a genuinely always-moving dense base texture, not one static effect.
Accent burst firing every 1-2 beats on top of the chase base. Meteors is an equally valid substitute for this accent role.

Templates.Name: Quiet-ballad hold-plus-pop
Templates.SourceNote: Derived from a real Tree/Matrix busiest-window scan (Carrie Underwood -- Away In A Manger extract); see docs/research/multilayer-template-exemplars/README.md. Palette-free and song-free.

Layers.Notes: Steady, low-intensity hold spanning the entire section -- a held layer is a steady state, never a dead frame; Twinkle keeps its own real per-frame animation at low duty.
A slow accent pop, each burst lasting several seconds with a soft ~0.4s fadeout -- restraint and a long cadence, not density.

Templates.Name: Mid-energy chase-and-accent Tree
Templates.SourceNote: Derived from a real Tree/Matrix busiest-window scan (Chuck Berry -- Run Rudolph Run extract); see docs/research/multilayer-template-exemplars/README.md. Palette-free and song-free.

Layers.Notes: Base layer carrying the section's color identity. Bars is an equally valid substitute for this base role.

Short accent bursts layered on top at roughly phrase-length intervals -- a middle ground between the EDM dense-canvas pattern and the quiet-ballad pattern. Twinkle is an equally valid substitute for this accent role.
